title: Paid but order unpaid
description: The amount left my bank account yesterday but the purchase still shows as waiting for payment.

title: Wallet not credited
description: I added funds to my wallet and my bank confirmed the transfer, but the balance in the app has not changed.

title: Renewal not applied
description: My subscription renewal was taken from my card this morning but my plan still shows as expired.

title: Flight purchase failed
description: The plane ticket purchase crashed at the last step. No ticket was issued but I was billed the full fare.

title: Room sold twice
description: I arrived at the hotel and another guest holds a confirmation for the same room on the same night. The hotel kept the earlier reservation, which was not mine.

title: Concert seats not issued
description: Checkout timed out while I was reserving two seats. I have no tickets, the seats now show as unavailable, and I was charged.

title: Package not at my door
description: Tracking says the package was handed over two days ago, but nothing arrived and my neighbours do not have it.

title: Shipment not moving
description: My shipment has had no tracking update for six days and the last scan was at a depot in another region.

title: Sent to the wrong city
description: The consignment is travelling to a city on the other side of the country from the address I gave.

title: Integration failing
description: Since 09:00 every call from our system to your endpoints hangs and then fails with a 504 response. Nothing changed on our side.

title: Everything is slow
description: The whole site is crawling for all of our staff and most pages end in an error. It started ten minutes ago.

title: Alerts arriving late
description: Status emails for all our customers are arriving several hours late since last night.

title: Cannot get in
description: I cannot get into my profile. It says my details are wrong.

title: Code not received
description: The one-time code never reaches my phone so I am locked out.

title: Something is wrong
description: It is not working. Please fix it as soon as possible.

title: Problem with my thing
description: I had an issue last week and it is still there.
